questions.question: Which of the following is a static mechanism for address allocation of IoT nodes?

options.B: IPv6 address based on a hardware identifier
options.C: Both configuration over a management interface & based on a hardware identifier
options.D: IoT nodes can’t be configured statically

questions.solution: IoT nodes can be statically configured in different ways, such as an address can be configured over a management interface, or a node may use IPv6 address based on a hardware identifier.

questions.question: Which of the following error is commonly found in heating of metal strips?
questions.solution: A hysteresis error causes the sensor output value to vary depending on the sensor’s previous input values. It is typically found in analog sensors, magnetic sensors, heating of metal strips.

questions.question: “X” performs active application layer functions between IoT nodes and other entities. What is X?
questions.solution: IoT proxy is an entity that performs an active application layer function between IoT nodes, and other entities. The IoT proxy can be collocated with the IoT gateway.

questions.question: Which of the following field in IPv4 header format indicates that it is concerned with reliable transmission?
questions.solution: The IPv4 emphasizes more on reliable transmission, as is evident by fields, such as type of service, total length, id, offset, TTL, checksum fields.

questions.question: Which of the following is a function of IoT Gateway?
questions.solution: An IoT gateway performs several critical functions, like switching, routing, translating protocols, firewall &VPN services, security, data forwarding, managing device, and filtering data.

questions.question: Which of the following actuator converts pressure into force?
questions.solution: Pneumatic actuators enable large forces to be produced from relatively small pressure changes (e.g., Pneumatic brakes are very responsive to small changes in pressure applied by the driver)

questions.question: Which of the following mechanism for address autoconfiguration provide more control on the allocated addresses?
questions.solution: DHCPv6 can be used to explicitly configure IPv6 addresses to nodes, thereby providing network administrators with added control over the nodes on their networks.

questions.question: Which of the following can measure position?
questions.solution: A potentiometer sensor measures the distance or displacement of an object in a linear or rotary motion and converts it into an electrical signal. An encoder is an electromechanical device that can measure motion or position.

questions.question: In a scenario when the IoT proxy has uplink connectivity, does the IoT LAN need global addressing mandatorily?
questions.solution: When the IoT proxy has uplink connectivity, it proxies communication between the local IoT nodes and nodes in the external network. In this scenario, where all communications go through a proxy, the IoT LAN does not need global addressing, but can manage with link-local or ULA addresses, depending on the type of proxy.

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE?

options.A: M2M is not a subset of IoT

questions.solution: M2M is a part of the IoT, where IoT has a broader scope than M2M. Both are different since M2M uses point-to-point communication. IoT and WoT aren’t same.

questions.question: Statement I: Aliasing error occurs if the input variable or added noise changes periodically at a frequency proportional to the multiple of the sampling rate. Statement II: If the signal is monitored digitally, the sampling frequency can cause a dynamic error triggering aliasing error.

options.A: Both Statement I and II are false
options.B: Both Statement I and II are true
options.C: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
options.D: Statement I is true but Statement II is false

questions.solution: If the signal is monitored digitally, the sampling frequency can cause a dynamic error, or if the input variable or added noise changes periodically at a frequency proportional to the multiple of the sampling rate, aliasing errors may occur.

questions.question: Does polymer-based actuator find application in manufacturing artificial muscles?
questions.solution: Shape memory polymer (SMP) actuators function similar to our muscles, even providing a response to a range of stimuli such as light, electrical, magnetic, heat, pH, and moisture changes.

questions.question: Unique Local Addresses are intended to allow routing over a network that expands over multiple links and routing hops, and even can expand over multiple networks. Can these addresses prevent address collision?
questions.solution: Unique Local Addresses are designed to be used in local networks larger than a single link, but not for communications through the Internet. However, these are designed to provide adequate uniqueness in order to have extremely small risk of address collision.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of vector sensor?
questions.solution: Physical quantities such as sound, image, velocity, acceleration, orientation, etc. are all vector quantities, as only their magnitude is not sufficient to convey the complete information.

questions.question: Which of the following protocol is used to implement device management for mobile devices?
questions.solution: OMA-DM is a protocol specified by the Open Mobile Alliance and is often used in the context of complex structured mobile solutions. It is often preferred by service providers to implement device management for mobile devices.

questions.question: In LOADng, can intermediate routers respond to Route Requests (RREQs)?

options.B: Yes, only when RREQ flooding occurs
options.C: Yes, only if they have active routes to the sought destination

questions.solution: Intermediate LOADng Routers are explicitly prohibited from responding to RREQs, even if they may have active routes to the sought destination.

questions.question: Which of the following functions as the network bridge in IEEE 802.15.4 network?
questions.solution: Every IEEE 802.15.4 network has a minimum of one coordinator device type who acts as the root; it also functions as the network bridge. The coordinator performs data handling and storing operations.

questions.question: Which of the following allow communication between Zigbee and no-Zigbee devices?
questions.solution: In order to enable communication between Zigbee and no-Zigbee devices, a layer-7 application-level gateway has to be created, which is quite complex. Refer to the book: S. Misra, A. Mukherjee, and A. Roy, 2020. Introduction to IoT. Cambridge University Press.

questions.question: Statement I: RFIDs are radio-frequency-based. Statement II: RFID devices can act as both readers as well as tags. Which one of the following is correct?

options.A: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
options.B: Statement I is false but Statement II is true

questions.solution: RFIDs are primarily radio-frequency-based, which can work even when they are not visible. These devices can’t act as both readers as well as tags.

questions.question: In AMQP, which of the following functionality defines its component “exchange”?

options.C: defines rules for message routing to various queues
options.D: routing the messages to various queues

questions.solution: Messages are not posted directly in the queue; rather, the user sends messages to the exchange. An exchange is responsible for routing the messages to the various queues.

questions.question: Which of the following is designed to have low overhead and better scalability in terms of dense networks?
questions.solution: RPL is designed to have low overhead and better scalability in terms of dense networks.

questions.question: Which of the following AMQP frame type controls the message flow rate?
questions.solution: “Flow” frame type controls the message flow rate.

questions.question: Does 6LoWPAN allow interoperability between IEEE802.15.4-based wireless devices and other IP-based devices?
questions.solution: 6LoWPAN allows interoperability between IEEE802.15.4-based wireless devices, as well as other IP-based devices. 6LoWPAN simply uses a bridge to enable communication between other devices. Refer to the book: S. Misra, A. Mukherjee, and A. Roy, 2020. Introduction to IoT. Cambridge University Press.

questions.question: In the context of XMPP, which of the following correctly defines BOSH?

options.C: Both XML streaming and HTTP binding

questions.solution: BOSH is the HTTP binding for XMPP communications that is intended to be used in situations where a device or client is unable to maintain a long-lived TCP connection to an XMPP server.

questions.question: Does MQTT support event-driven architecture?
questions.solution: MQTT protocol uses a publish/subscribe architecture. Publish/subscribe is event‐driven and enables messages to be pushed to clients.

questions.question: Which of the following is the acronym for “Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol”?
questions.solution: XMPP stands for Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol.

questions.question: An IoT network requires communication mechanism, which is capable of synchronous as well as asynchronous communication. The mechanism should support both request-response, as well as publish-subscribe models. Which of the following protocol would be best suited for such a mechanism?
questions.solution: CoAP is capable of synchronous as well as asynchronous communication. It supports both request-response as well as publish-subscribe models. Refer to the book: S. Misra, A. Mukherjee, and A. Roy, 2020. Introduction to IoT. Cambridge University Press.

questions.question: Which of the following technique is used to transmit data frames in Beacon-enabled IEEE 802.15.4 networks?
questions.solution: The periodic transmission of beacon messages characterizes beacon enabled networks. Here, the data frames are sent via slotted CSMA/CA with a super-frame structure managed by a personal area network (PAN) coordinator.

questions.question: What is the maximum size of hop limit in 6LoWPAN packet format?
questions.solution: Hop limit in 6LoWPAN packet format allows up to 8-bit unsigned integer. Decremented by 1 by each node that forwards the packet. The packet is discarded if Hop Limit is decremented to zero.

questions.question: Which of the following UAV topology is self-configuring?
questions.solution: Star topology is not self-configuring, while mesh topology is self- configuring.

options.C: Both scalar and camera sensor nodes

questions.solution: In WMSNs application, deployment of both camera sensor and scalar sensor nodes can provide better sensing and prolong network lifetime. Camera sensor

questions.question: In which of the following algorithms only a subset of nodes in the WASN participate in sensing, communication, and computation?
questions.solution: Localized algorithms are a special type of distributed algorithms where only a subset of nodes in the WASN participate in sensing, communication, and computation.

questions.question: Which of the following components in M2M monitors the status of devices and M2M area networks, and controls them based on their status?
questions.solution: M2M device platform manages device profiles, such as location, device type, address, and description. It monitors the status of devices and M2M area networks, and controls them based on their status.

questions.question: In the guided target-tracking problem formulation, a tracker is added to the problem. The tracker follows the trajectory defined by beacon nodes to intercept the target. Which of the following objectives best define this tracking algorithm?

options.A: to fuse data about the target
options.B: to use the least amount of communication to reach the target
options.C: to reach the target in the shortest possible time

questions.solution: The tracker can be a person or a guided vehicle that receives the position of the target from the network so that it can move toward the target. The objective is to reach the target in the shortest possible time.

questions.question: In gateway selection algorithm in FANETs, each UAV acquires the information of all UAVs within its ________ hop(s).
questions.solution: In gateway selection algorithm in FANETs, gateway selection is initiated by selection of the most stable node in the sub‐area. Each UAV acquires the information of all UAVs within its 2 hops.

questions.question: A crossing is covered if it is in the _________ region of at least one node’s coverage disk.
questions.solution: Crossings are the intersection points between disk boundaries or between monitored space boundary and disk boundaries. A crossing is covered if it is in the interior region of at least one node’s coverage disk.

questions.question: There are several major challenges related to target-tracking applications. Which of the following is NOT among those challenges?
questions.solution: Authors identified six major challenges related to target-tracking applications. These are target detection, target recovery, energy management, position computation, node cooperation, and future-position estimation. Node cooperation is one of the challenges, in which nodes cooperate and fuse data, reducing the number of messages.

questions.question: Which of the following components in M2M manages inquiry?
questions.solution: M2M User Platform manages M2M service user profiles and provides functionalities such as, user registration, modification, charging, and inquiry.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT regarded as one of the major scatters of underwater sound in Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks?

questions.question: In Optimal Geographical Density Control (OGDC) algorithm, a node _________ if its coverage area is completely covered.
questions.solution: In OGDC, a node closest to the optimal location becomes active. A node sleeps if its coverage area is completely covered.

questions.question: Which of the following elements of target-tracking algorithm can perform data fusion?
questions.solution: A sink node is the intermediary between the network and application user. It is a special node with high processing power and storage. It can perform data fusion.

questions.question: Which of the following components of Mobile Wireless Sensor Networks (MWSN) moves in order to collect data from sensor nodes?

questions.solution: Mobile Sink moves in order to collect data from sensor nodes. A data mule also moves to collect the data from sensor nodes and goes to the sink to deliver the collected data.

questions.question: Suppose data from an IoT device first goes to Fog layer for some basic processing, after which it goes to Cloud layer for advanced processing, then the processed data comes back to the Fog layer and then, it finally comes back to the origin sensor node. In the return journey no processing of data takes place anywhere, just transfer of data takes place. If ‘Tf’ is the time taken by the data to travel from sensor to fog and vice versa, and ‘Tc’ is the time taken by the data to travel from fog to cloud and vice versa, ‘Tfp’ is the data processing time at fog and ‘Tcp’ is the data processing time at cloud, what is the total round trip time ‘T’ taken by data starting from the origin sensor node, processing the data and then back to the sensor node after being processed.
questions.solution: Since data comes back to the origin sensor node, the traversal latency Tf and Tc will be counted twice. But, since processing takes place only once during onward journey, processing delay is only one time. Therefore, T = 2(Tf + Tc) + Tfp + Tcp.
